correctness.rationale: The proof derives a necessary and sufficient row-versus-column palette condition for every nonisolated cell, proves the n-clique lower bound and automatic rectangular case, excludes n and n+1 colors in squares using exact missing-color multiplicity equality, and gives an n+2 cyclic construction whose omitted-pair gaps cannot coincide modulo n+2>=4. The singleton is handled separately. Finite independent direct enumeration checked 156563 proper arrays and 91 constructions; the general claim relies on proof, not tests.

value.rationale: The work determines a sharp all-parameter PCF invariant with an infinite exact two-color obstruction gap between squares and rectangles, explains the obstruction structurally using synchronized missing-color row/column sets, and classifies which individual proper rook colorings satisfy PCF. It strictly refines general quasi-line upper bounds and is a natural line-graph/combinatorial-matrix theorem, not a fixed small computation.
